main_text.p: siu[illegible, ~1 letter]primi Canones istos Apostolis adscri-pserunt, cùm tamen hac in re collectorum vestigia sint secuti, nec ab illis vel minimum discesserint, nisi forte in eo quod Clementem Canonum Scriptorem arbi-trati sunt. Hinc consequitur 1. vanissimam esse Beveregii ad Dallæi argumentum res-ponsionem, quando nunc constat ipsos Canonum collectores eos Apostolis tribuisse; 2. seculo tertio non extitisse horum Canonum Codicem, aliter eum commemo-raturi erant Eusebius, Hieronymus, aliique ejusdem ætatis cum utrovis Scripto-res, cùm illum præsertin Sanctis Domini Apostolis affictum viderent; 3. Non Ecclesiasticos vocatos fuisse olim hos Canones, ut tradit pluribus in locis Vir doctus, sed Apostolicos; Nam ab Apostolis condi-tos esse, omnibus persuasum voluerunt eorum primi collectores; 4. ab Apostolicis Viris in unum corpus minimè collectos fuisse, quicquid dicat Beveregius; Nam Apostolici Viri Apostolis Canones non erât adscripturi, quos ab illis haudquaquam sancitos probè noverant; Restat igitur ut ab impostore quodam conflati sint ac con-sarcinati, & in hanc quam videmus spe-ciem compositi.

page.notes: The blot over the "m" of "siumprimi" in the first line hides letters; the first word is marked illegible. The page number is printed as "51" with a blurred final digit; the reading "51" is uncertain. "præsertin" is probably a printing error for "præsertim" and is left as printed. "Dallæi" and "Dallæani" are kept as printed. A blot before "2." in the line "2. seculo" is ink, not a mark, and is not transcribed. The specks in the left margin are not text. The "X." in the right margin is a section marker and is kept as a note.
